'''''Studies of the Force''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] [[Writing/Legends|written]] by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]], who was the first teacher of [[Satele Shan]]. Shan, who later became the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], brought a copy of ''Studies of the Force'' with her on her self-imposed exile to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]
[[Odessen]].
